title: Library page search bar should not float while scrolling

requirements.summary: Remove sticky/fixed positioning from the Library page search bar wrapper so it stays in normal document flow and never overlaps content.
acceptanceCriteria: On the Library page, the search bar remains in the normal document flow and does not move when scrolling the page content.
The search bar does not overlap subsequent content; content starts below it as expected.
No sticky/fixed behavior remains for the Library page search bar (no `position: sticky/fixed` styling and no `top: var(--header-offset)` dependency).

file_operations.description: Update the search bar wrapper (currently using `className="sticky ..."` plus `style={{ top: 'var(--header-offset)' }}`) to use non-sticky/static flow layout (e.g., remove `sticky` and remove the inline `top` style entirely). Ensure any z-index choices do not cause overlay since the element should be in normal flow.

requirements.summary: Add a reusable non-floating search bar CSS utility class and apply it on the Library page for explicit intent.
acceptanceCriteria: `frontend/src/index.css` contains a clearly named class (or documented snippet) for a non-sticky page search bar (relative/static positioning, `top: 0`, and a non-problematic `z-index`).
The Library page search bar styling is updated to use the new class/snippet or an equivalent Tailwind class combination, and the search bar no longer floats on scroll.

file_operations.description: Add a reusable, clearly named CSS class for page-level search bars that must not float (e.g., sets `position: relative` or `static`, `top: 0`, and a safe `z-index` that does not overlay content). Place it in an appropriate Tailwind layer section (e.g., `@layer components` or similar) and include a brief comment describing intended usage.

Apply the new non-floating search bar CSS class to the Library page search bar wrapper (or use an equivalent explicit Tailwind class set) so the non-sticky positioning intent is clear and consistent with the new global snippet.
